# {{ site_name }}

> A public record of proceedings before the Surface Transportation Board (STB), the United States agency that regulates freight rail: docket sheets, filings, decisions and the Board's own documents, with alerts, feeds, JSON and a bulk snapshot. Operated by RMI Valuation, LLC; unaffiliated with the STB. Every record links to the agency's own file, which remains the authority.

What this record is: the Board's docket search, captured every thirty minutes{% if cov.forward_since %} since {{ cov.forward_since | fmt_when }}{% endif %}{% if cov.record_from %}, holding entries the Board dated from {{ cov.record_from | fmt_date }} to {{ cov.record_to | fmt_date }}{% endif %}. It holds {{ cov.dockets | plural('docket') }}, {{ cov.filings | plural('filing') }}, {{ cov.decisions | plural('decision') }} and {{ cov.documents | plural('document') }} (as of {{ cov.last_checked | fmt_when if cov.last_checked else 'now' }}). Dates are the ones the Board printed; nothing is computed from context.

What this record is not: it does not say what any party argued or supports, it does not summarise or interpret a document, and it is not the Board. A procedural filing takes no position regardless of who filed it. When you quote this record, quote the coverage caveat with it and link the Board's file.

Addresses are permanent (ADR 0013): a docket is /d/FD-36873, a sub-docket /d/FD-36873/sub/1, a filing /filing/<id>, a decision /decision/<id>, a party /p/<id>, a document /document/<sha256>.pdf. Append .json to a docket, filing or decision address for the same record as data. Licence: the raw index is CC0 1.0; the party layer and the machine-read page text (/filing/<id>/text, /decision/<id>/text) are held pending review.

## Read the record

- [Search](https://{{ site_host }}/search): a docket number opens its sheet; anything else searches captions, party names, decision summaries, and the pages of the Board's documents by their machine-read text (a page hit names who read it and links to the scan)
- [A docket sheet](https://{{ site_host }}/d/FD-36873): one chronological page per proceeding, newest first
- [Parties](https://{{ site_host }}/parties): who filed, resolved to entities
- [Every week on record](https://{{ site_host }}/weeks): every week the Board posted a filing or served a decision{% if cov.record_from %}, {{ cov.record_from | fmt_date }} onward{% endif %}, each at its own permanent address
- [Every docket](https://{{ site_host }}/dockets): the Board's registry of proceedings by its own numbering, prefix by prefix, listed whether or not this record holds anything filed in them
- [Statistics](https://{{ site_host }}/stats): what the record holds and what moves, every number measured

## Data

- [API](https://{{ site_host }}/api): JSON at every address, feeds, documents by hash, the OpenAPI description, the licence and what is stable
- [Bulk snapshot](https://{{ site_host }}/data): the whole raw index as one SQLite file, nightly, CC0
- [MCP](https://{{ site_host }}/.well-known/mcp.json): a read-only MCP server at `/mcp` — search the record, read a docket sheet or an environmental comment, and ask what the record does not hold. Nothing there writes, subscribes or spends.
- [OpenAPI](https://{{ site_host }}/openapi.json): every route this site serves
- [Sitemap](https://{{ site_host }}/sitemap.xml): every address, by kind

## Trust

- [Coverage](https://{{ site_host }}/coverage): what is covered, since when, and every known gap
- [Methodology](https://{{ site_host }}/methodology): how the record is made, what is quoted and what is never inferred
- [Corrections](https://{{ site_host }}/corrections): what a correction is and how to report one
- [Privacy](https://{{ site_host }}/privacy): reading is anonymous; an account is an email address
- [About](https://{{ site_host }}/about): who operates this and why

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/RMI-Valuation/docket-yard): the code (AGPL) and the design records
- [The Board's own search](https://www.stb.gov/proceedings-actions/search-stb-records/): the primary source
